one_line_conclusion: Q-TRANSPORT improves target group ranking over source-LR ERM on UNSW/CIC/BoT and degrades it on ToN, so it is a conditionally effective representation module rather than a general ERM replacement. Against the matched native control the advantage is sign-stable on UNSW only (9/9 seeds), the disadvantage is sign-stable on ToN (9/9), and CIC and BoT are within seed noise. The matched control is itself highly seed-sensitive (nine-seed SD 0.126 on BoT), so any single-triple comparison of the two is uninformative.
statistical_unit: 4 targets x 9 seeds x 3 arms, cross-runner paired comparison
error_representation: sample SD over 9 seeds (panel B); all 9 per-seed paired deltas (panel C); exact distribution over all C(9,3)=84 3-seed subsets of the basis (panel D)
pairing_integrity: source_erm (Q runner) and native78_pooled (control runner) agree to 0.00e+00 on all 4 targets and all 9 seeds, which is what makes the per-seed pairing valid
quantile_cap: quantile cap REMOVED in v2: edges are exact quantiles of the full sample. The cap's metric-level effect was measured on 9 paired seeds per target and is negligible (nine-seed mean q_exact - q_capped = UNSW -0.0010, CIC -0.0005, BoT -0.0007, ToN +0.0003)
seed_basis: nine ordinary integers [1, 7, 42, 99, 1234, 2026, 2027, 2028, 55555]. Three date-like seeds present in the original sweep are excluded from every value plotted here; the nominal triple 2026/2027/2028 is a subset of the basis, used only for cross-chapter comparison, not a second basis.
seed_limitation: the v1 caveat that Q-side SD was only a lower bound because fit_zi_edges() hardcoded a fixed rng is CLOSED: v2 computes exact quantiles and the measured cap effect is negligible
arm_naming_warning: control arm is native78_shared_expert_median, NOT the sibling native78_expert_median which gives materially different values
naming_change: 'CPU ERM' retired in favour of 'source-LR ERM (pooled)'; the old name described the hardware rather than the method. Machine key remains source_erm.
evaluation_scope: FixedTest; inductive CDF from target-train only
